acceptanceCriteria: The owner promotes v0-5 to v0-7 in order, or records a decision on how published pre-releases relate to store promotion.
v0-8 reaches candidate and readiness reports its gates.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. `corvint-tasks release readiness` for v0-8 is BLOCKED only on candidate: the release record lists no missing tickets although six scoped tickets were OPEN (V1-0016, V1-0023, V1-0154, V1-0191, V1-0195, V1-0201), and `release candidate` refuses because its predecessors were never promoted (v0-5 is candidate only; v0-6 and v0-7 are not candidates). 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 were published as GitHub pre-releases without store promotion. Promotion is owner-only. Route chosen in decision 0381 item 10: v0-7 follows v0-5, v0-9 follows v0-6 and v0-8, promote v0-5, v0-7, v0-8, then v0-6 after V1-0011.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0235: commit c139a7ec; AC1: accepted decision 0381 §10 defines store promotion versus published prereleases; AC2: .taskman/releases/v0-8.json retains candidate 142d6790, five PASS gate attestations and owner promotion; release readiness exposes those attestations. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch B) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: release chain: v0-5, v0-6 and v0-7 were never promoted, so v0-8 cannot become a candidate
